text: Write one compact JSON record to creative-direction.json. Use validate_creative_direction() before construction. This is the shared direction record; do not repeat it in separate creative/imagery/reference briefs.
note: Fifth home of the direction step.

text: For a required authentic target logo on a pageless scene, only explicit page dimensions may be compiled first … Creative nodes and new imagery spend still require validated direction.
note: Fourth home of the page-only logo preparation rule.

text: Round direction.md can refer to it and contain only the repair delta.
note: The system prompt calls these "optional notes in rounds/round_N"; the follow-up routine forbids them.

text: The tool returns the direction digest and indexed review requirements. Carry that result into current-scene review. A semantic revision after validation uses validate_creative_direction(revision_reason=…); the new direction needs fresh review. Reformatting the same JSON is not a revision.
Required fields: schema_version 1; objective, audience; playbook (one registered ID); intent: native, reuse, edit, close_companion, new_concept or palette_only.
note: `intent` has no value for a revamp of an existing ad, and the six values are not defined here (references.md uses them for imagery). In the revamp the agent chose new_concept while keeping the layout.

text: copy: list of {id, role, text, claim_kind, evidence_refs}. New creatives need copy; an edit intent may use an empty list for a logo/geometry-only change. Roles headline/support/cta/attribution; claim kind positioning/assertion/quote/statistic. Assertion/quote/statistic needs evidence IDs. A quote also requires an attribution copy block. CTA is optional.

evidence: list of {id, source, excerpt}. Point to supplied or actually retrieved evidence … model-authored source descriptions, not independently verified … Record limiting/contrary evidence honestly.
source_roles: list of {asset_id, role}. Role is source/treatment/composition/logo/product; asset IDs must be available in this run's sources.

preserve, vary: string lists of visible properties; no contradictory entry. Resolve source/kit differences here before authoring … Name deliberate departures in vary/assumptions and leave an unavailable required treatment as a gap. A near-white promise with a visibly gray chosen fill is a conflict.
note: preserve/vary is where the revamp wrote "the current layout remains the composition"; nothing says what a revamp should put in vary.

text: layers: list of {id, kind, purpose, placement, …}. Kinds native_text, native_geometry, authentic_image, generated_image. Native text binds copy_id … Generated layers can name ordered reference_asset_ids and aligned reference_roles (at most four).
Each layer's placement: {x, y, width, height, fit} as fractions of the artboard within 0..1 … these are intent, not locked boxes. Artboard placement: {width, height, unit}.
review_needs: nonempty list of specific checks; assumptions: concise list.
note: review_needs is written by the agent and later used as its own acceptance checklist (circular review).

text: Keep real logo/product images independent … Registered evidence prerequisites: authentic-product requires an independent supplied product image; attributed-proof requires sourced quote/statistic and attribution. These prerequisites apply to new work and edits.

Retain the relevant unchanged proof/source bindings in this direction during a narrow repair; the round delta names which existing components to mutate. Including unchanged attribution in the direction does not authorize a collateral change. Intent=edit alone never permits missing required evidence.

Revisit the relevant skills at any stage and amend this same record explicitly if the copy, intent, sources or layer plan changes. Call the same validator after a revision … It checks structure, references, available assets and evidence prerequisites … It cannot prove truth or visual quality.

Whole-creative review binds this declared copy to the actual exported native text inventory … If the authored words change beyond whitespace reflow, revise this record with a reason before reviewing … Passing candidate review requires source_gaps: [].
